name: Michoacan de Ocampo
summary_text: The state has not typified hate crime at all, per its own LGBT+ welfare sub-director (June 2026), who also located most attacks on the community in Tierra Caliente, the zone of armed-group influence. Six LGBT+ homicides were recorded in the first four and a half months of 2026 alone, including 'Daniela,' a trans woman found beaten to death in a drainage channel in Morelia on 2 April 2026 — a suspect was arrested, a positive institutional response. Two additional deaths in Morelia in April 2026, one of them a gay man, were linked by the attorney general's office to organised crime. An NGO observatory report counted 46 LGBT+ homicides in Michoacán between 2015 and 2024, led by Morelia (11), then Lázaro Cárdenas (6), Apatzingán and Uruapan (5) and Zamora (4), with 2015 the deadliest year (10 victims). Colectivo PRIDE Michoacán reports rising attacks in the municipalities bordering Jalisco, that victims are no longer attended to, and that the state does not acknowledge the violence. No transfeminicide offence, no hate-crime typification, no investigative protocol — the only counterweights are individual arrests. Context for comparison: Veracruz, similarly hostile, at least passed a gender-identity civil-code reform in 2025; Mexico City pairs comparable lethality with a dedicated transfeminicide investigation unit and mandatory-response protocols. Michoacán has no legal machinery whatsoever, plus an armed-group amplifier that makes the violence harder to escape or report.

sources.title: Suman 46 homicidios LGBT+ en Michoacán entre 2015 y 2024 - Quadratín Michoacán
sources.claim_summary: Quadratín Justicia (16 May 2025), citing the 'Crímenes y Agresiones contra Personas LGBT+ en el estado de Michoacán' observatory report: 46 LGBT+ homicides in Michoacán 2015-2024; Morelia led with 11, then Lázaro Cárdenas 6, Apatzingán and Uruapan 5, Zamora 4, Paracho/Jacona/Tarímbaro 2, nine municipalities with 1; 2015 the deadliest year (10 victims); collective Michoacán es Diversidad presented the figures.
